call.x: EIT Regional Innovation Booster Poland Open Call 2026/27 Opportunity 25/11/2026 17.00 - CET 27/01/2027 16.00 - CET EIT The EIT Regional Innovation Booster (RIB) Poland call is now open. It offers up to 25 mature Polish companies free online mentoring to prepare their entry into Germany, Spain or the Nordic countries. EIT RIB Poland is an online mentoring programme delivered by the European Institute of Innovation and Technology (EIT). Each company is matched with an EIT RIB Buddy, an expert in its sector and target market. The Buddy helps with regulations, potential customers and partners, and first business contacts. HE-GA-B.title: Horizon Europe Work Programme 2026-2027, General Annexes, B - Eligibility

consortium.quote: Unless otherwise provided for in the specific call/topic conditions, only legal entities forming a consortium are eligible to participate in actions provided that the consortium includes, as beneficiaries, three legal entities independent from each other and each established in a different country as follows: – at least one independent legal entity established in a Member State; and – at least two other independent legal entities, each established in different Member States or Associated Countries.
